summary: Test suite comprehensively covers core requirements: parsing both manifest types (package.json, requirements.txt), license classification (approved/denied/unknown), report generation, CLI argument handling, and end-to-end workflow execution. Unit tests (15 tests) cover all four main functions plus error paths. Workflow tests (10 tests) verify YAML structure, actionlint validation, and execution through act with three realistic fixture cases. However, rigor is limited—missing explicit shellcheck and bash -n syntax validation tests (required by task), no edge case testing (malformed JSON, empty manifests, special characters), no permission/read error handling tests. Design has a critical fragility: setup_file() runs all three act cases upfront and caches results; a single case failure skips all subsequent workflow tests in that file. String assertions using [[ $output == *pattern* ]] are brittle to whitespace changes. Would catch major functional regressions but likely miss edge cases, syntax errors, and subtle input handling issues.
